current.text: He is projected to come off the bench. The projected Spurs bench is Champagnie, Harris, Kornet, Keldon Johnson and Bryant, behind starters Fox, Harper, Castle, Vassell and Wembanyama.
He is likely about the eighth man in the rotation, still ahead of Harrison Barnes.
This is a contract year for him.
The Spurs lean toward starting three guards. That leaves a bench made up only of forwards, so he competes with several forwards for minutes.
The Spurs are deep, and minutes may stay low after their long playoff run.
The roster is very deep at forward. Trades to consolidate it are expected in the relatively near future.
Expect a significantly worse season than last year. Outside the top 200 on Yahoo is where he belongs.
The Spurs play 3-4-3 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21 and have only 13 back-to-backs this season.

durable.text: He is bad for fantasy. He is a usage-sponge driver who does not pass or defend and is not a reliable three-point shooter.
He is not starting caliber. His numbers as a starter years ago were his ceiling. He plays very much like Saddiq Bey.
He has won the Sixth Man of the Year award.

note: Both sites price him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 217, ESPN rank 152), and our league did not draft him last season. That puts him well outside our 144-player draft, so do not bid on him. His projected line has no category that stands out (AST, STL and BLK all sit near -1.0 z), so he fits no build in particular. Early in the season, check only whether the three-guard lineup or a forward injury lifts his minutes clearly above last season's 23 per game before you look at him on waivers.
